title: tree-sitter 0.25.10 → 0.27.0 in the osf crate
summary: A dependency bump: the `osf` crate pins `tree-sitter` to 0.27.0 instead of 0.25.10, and Cargo.lock follows with the new version, checksum, and a dropped `regex-syntax` transitive dependency. No source code changes — the Rust parser grammar (`tree-sitter-rust` 0.24.2) and every consumer of the tree-sitter runtime are untouched, so the blast radius is the parser runtime ABI underneath the osf crate's syntax analysis.

nodes.summary: The Rust grammar binding, still pinned at 0.24.2. It is compiled against the runtime, so it is the first thing that would notice an ABI break in the bump — but its pin did not move.
